policy: Existing typed graph projection; raw kinds retained. No edge is promoted to a proved implication or compatible interface.

scoped_relations.relation_coverage: Only explicit source-backed distinctions and scoped notices are recorded; topical similarity does not establish theorem transfer or exhaustive dependency coverage.

evidence.range_scope: Rendered XH1 completion report; model-level source claims only.
evidence.status: Exact selected source bytes; source-reported only; this integration does not independently certify the result.

requires_external_validation.scope: Specify a non-biological, experimentally measurable reaction cycle with acquired rates, material and energy balances, recovery, lifetime, and a matched staged-chemistry comparator before claiming capability.
